Messages.Author: Alex
Messages.Body:
Q: Matthias plays Anesthetic Touch (AT) at OBE against Anvil. If Anvil
fails to prevent the damage from AT, can Matthias play Pulled Fangs
before/after combat has ended due to AT? Could Matthias play an
Amaranth if the AT sent Anvil to torpor?

Q: Is Coagulated Entity (CE) permanent? For instance, if Ilse
successfully plays CE while there are a total of 3 Blood Brothers (BB)
in play, does Ilse become a 9 capacity BB with base +3 strength (if
all 3 BB moved a blood to Ilse)?

If CE is blocked, is the acting Blood Brother still entitled to the +X
strength, +X capacity bonuses during combat and/or afterwards as a
permanent (based on previous question)? or does combat simply begin
with the blocking minion and the CE is sent to the ash heap without
any effect?

Thanks in advance.

-Alex

Messages.Author: GreySeer
Messages.Body:
"Alex" <ahar...@yahoo.com> wrote in message
news:3eac2586.01122...@posting.google.com...

> Q: Matthias plays Anesthetic Touch (AT) at OBE against Anvil. If Anvil
> fails to prevent the damage from AT, can Matthias play Pulled Fangs
> before/after combat has ended due to AT? Could Matthias play an
> Amaranth if the AT sent Anvil to torpor?

I'd say yes in both cases, you play those cards as combat is ending ( wether
it's from sending the opposing minion to torpor or AT's effect ) but LSJ
should probably answer that one.

> Q: Is Coagulated Entity (CE) permanent? For instance, if Ilse
> successfully plays CE while there are a total of 3 Blood Brothers (BB)
> in play, does Ilse become a 9 capacity BB with base +3 strength (if
> all 3 BB moved a blood to Ilse)?

This was answered before by LSJ recently, no, it is not permenant.

> If CE is blocked, is the acting Blood Brother still entitled to the +X
> strength, +X capacity bonuses during combat and/or afterwards as a
> permanent (based on previous question)? or does combat simply begin
> with the blocking minion and the CE is sent to the ash heap without
> any effect?

If the action is blocked then the card text doesn't take effect, just like
any other action card.
